subject: mathematics
title: Area Detectives
objective: Solve simple problems about the area of squares and rectangles using length × width.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Area measures the space inside a shape. For a rectangle, multiply its length by its width and write square units. Ready to explore?
